resolved_findings.title: Support clocks were not bound to independently reconstructed source eligibility
resolved_findings.evidence: The original verifier derived wanted from audit.support.eligible_anchors and checked the resulting rank clock. It did not compare that support object against identities, scenes, historical candidates, or the independently replayed cross_scene_positive_counts. The sealed R2 verify_balance did make that comparison.
resolved_findings.impact: A consistently wrong support flag and rank clock could pass the new scalar-state checks despite real cross-scene positive support. Support is the treatment-defining state transition.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Reconstruct cross-scene positive counts and the support dictionary from already-recorded identities/scenes/memory, bind the relation counts, and derive wanted from those reconstructed values.
resolved_findings.validation: Independent stdlib audit-prefix regression: wrong_support_consistent_wrong_clock was accepted before and rejected after.

resolved_findings.title: Required direct-component references and update witnesses were optional to the verifier
resolved_findings.evidence: The top-level verifier required one capacity direct-total check, but verify_states allowed all per-role direct R/A component references to be empty. It also did not validate actual_parameter_updates or total backward counters. These checks existed in the sealed R2 scalar verifier.
resolved_findings.impact: An M0 record could omit the required five component references for each of three roles and still satisfy this verifier's audit portion. Missing/nonfinite update witnesses and wrong aggregate backward counts were not rejected.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Require references exactly when the direct-total check exists, require all three roles and five components, enforce 15 component checks and four direct backward calls per capacity, check per-step/total counters, and validate the existing update-pair witnesses.
resolved_findings.validation: Independent stdlib audit-prefix regression: missing_direct_component_references, missing_role_update_witnesses, nonfinite_role_update_witness, and wrong_total_backward_count were accepted before and rejected after; valid fixture accepted both.
